A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|'''bounty hunter''']] followed retired bounty hunter [[Garris Shrike]] for the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] alias, Vykk Draygo. After tracking Solo down through Shrike on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], he shot and [[Death/Legends|killed]] Shrike. However, Solo proved too much for the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]]. During a scuffle, his head impacted with a building and cracked, killing him. In the aftermath of the firefight, Solo switched clothes with the deceased hunter and placed his own fake [[Identichip/Legends|IDs]] on the body before he blasted the corpse's face with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. He then pushed the corpse over the edge of the [[Permacrete/Legends|permacrete]] to fall down one of Coruscant's deep airshafts.<ref name="The Paradise Snare" />
